description: Browser terminal supports interactive CLIs with PTY resize, cursor reporting, binary-safe I/O, and reconnect-safe input handling

requirements.description: Go API manages PTY sessions: create shell process with pty.StartWithSize, track sessions by ID, support concurrent sessions, clean up on termination.
requirements.title: PTY Session Backend

validation.notes: Session create returns valid ID and starts shell
PTY factory creates and manages process lifecycle
Shell resolution falls back to $SHELL env

requirements.description: WebSocket endpoint streams bidirectional I/O between browser and PTY. JSON message protocol with stdin, stdout, resize, exit, error, ping/pong types.
requirements.title: WebSocket I/O Streaming

validation.notes: Subscribe/broadcast delivers PTY output to connected clients
BAS case launches terminal command and verifies websocket traffic plus rendered command marker
BAS case sends keyboard stdin to an empty shell and verifies stdout round-trip marker

requirements.description: Binary-safe I/O protocol transmits raw bytes without encoding corruption. JSON message framing preserves binary payloads.
requirements.title: Binary-Safe I/O Protocol

validation.notes: WebSocket message types defined and parsed correctly

requirements.description: Terminal resize messages propagate from browser to PTY via pty.Setsize. SIGWINCH handling ensures interactive CLIs (vim, htop) reflow correctly.
requirements.title: Terminal Resize Handling

validation.notes: Test PTY resize handling with Setsize
Fake PTY resize delegates to SetSize

requirements.description: xterm.js terminal emulator renders PTY output with full ANSI/cursor support. Addon fitAddon auto-sizes terminal to container.
requirements.title: xterm.js Terminal Rendering

validation.notes: ANSI escape codes available for terminal output formatting
Terminal pane selector registered in selector registry
ErrorBoundary renders fallback on crash, resets on Try Again click

title: Production-Grade Web Terminal Fidelity
